continuation.derivation: continuation(provider) = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = root, salt = empty, info = "toon-network-continuation:" || <provider pubkey, 64 lowercase hex>, L = 32)
continuation.request_id: 32 random bytes per request. These fixtures derive theirs from a label so the files are reproducible; a real tenant draws them at random.

fixture.description: The fixed world every other fixture was generated in: the clock, the test-only keys, the kind numbers and the signing rule.

label: toon.network

signing.applies_to: the published events only. A Lease Request is signed by nobody (spec §6.1, ADR 0016).
signing.aux_rand: 32 zero bytes, so every fixture signature is reproducible; real signers use fresh randomness
signing.id: sha256 over the NIP-01 serialization [0, pubkey, created_at, kind, tags, content]
signing.sig: BIP-340 Schnorr over the id, by the event's pubkey

warning: TEST-ONLY KEYS, published on purpose. Never fund, trust or reuse them.
